payload.description_html: (A–D) Right maxilla IPS50119 from the middle Miocene, MN7+8, of ACM/C4-C2 in lateral (A), medial (B), dorsal (C), and ventral (D) views. (E–H) Same as above but right maxilla IPS50292 from ACM/C3-A6. Note the medially expanded ascending surface of the facial process and the evident lateral sulcus developed along the narial margin.
